name: Qantas
headquarters: Mascot, Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
tagline: The Flying Kangaroo - founded in outback Queensland in 1920 and now the world's oldest continuously operating airline still flying under its original name.
bio: Qantas began on 16 November 1920 as the Queensland and Northern Territory Aerial Services, carrying mail and passengers between remote outback towns in war-surplus biplanes. That acronym became one of aviation's most famous names, and the airline one of its great long-haul pioneers: the Kangaroo Route to London, flying boats across the Empire, and in the jet age a fleet built around the Boeing 747, which served Qantas for half a century.

As Australia's flag carrier, Qantas has specialised in some of the longest routes on Earth - it operated the A380 on trunk routes to Los Angeles and London from 2008, and its Project Sunrise plans aim at non-stop Sydney-to-London flights. The airline is equally known for its safety reputation and for the red-and-white kangaroo tail that has marked Australian aviation on six continents.
